title: Baloch group holds protest rally in Hannover against human rights abuses
seoTitle: Hannover rally against Baloch human rights abuses

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against alleged human rights abuses, enforced disappearances, and military operations by Pakistani forces.
tea.want: They demanded independent investigations into civilian deaths, accountability for perpetrators, and self-determination for the Baloch nation.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Reports detailed that the Baloch National Movement organised a protest rally outside the Lower Saxony State Parliament.

summary: The Baloch National Movement organised a protest rally in Hannover, Germany, to draw attention to alleged human rights violations, enforced disappearances, and extrajudicial killings by Pakistani forces in Balochistan. The march began in the central Kröpcke area and proceeded to the Lower Saxony State Parliament, where participants chanted slogans and distributed informational leaflets. Speakers from the Baloch National Movement and the Pashtun Tahafuz Movement addressed the gathering, highlighting civilian casualties from military operations and citing human rights reports. They urged the international community and the United Nations to ensure independent investigations into the abuses and to hold those responsible accountable, while asserting the Baloch nation's right to self-determination.
demands: Independent investigations into civilian deaths and military airstrikes
Accountability for human rights violations in Balochistan
End to enforced disappearances and arbitrary detentions
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Baloch National Movement held a protest rally in Hannover, marching from Kröpcke to the Lower Saxony State Parliament.
